name: DripDrop ORS Electrolyte Powder (Watermelon)
whyItWorks: Physician-developed oral rehydration formula with half the sugar of sports drinks and 3x the electrolytes. Its low osmolarity (220 mOsm/L) prevents osmotic fluid shifts into the bowel lumen, delivering rapid relief from flare dehydration.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stir 1 packet into 8 oz cold water and sip steadily over 20 minutes.
